episode.logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
episode.continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Condescending):
events.text: "Look at you."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous):
events.text: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Taunting):
events.text: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Steady):
events.text: "You seem very pleased."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Chilling):
events.text: "I am."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister):
events.text: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Scornful):
events.text: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful):
events.text: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken):
events.text: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter):
events.text: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Gloating):
events.text: "Do you remember?"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted):
events.text: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous):
events.text: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Proud, Measured):
events.text: "Gerald chose money."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Resolute):
events.text: "Clarissa chose a coward."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Unyielding):
events.text: "I chose myself."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Disgusted):
events.text: "You chose a beggar."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Proud):
events.text: "I chose a man."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Contemptuous):
events.text: "A scarred nobody."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified):
events.text: "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking):
events.text: "You call that marriage?"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Pure, Sincere):
events.text: "I call it love."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh):
events.text: "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Firm, Piercing):
events.text: "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended):
events.text: "You think love makes you better than me?"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):
events.text: "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful):
events.text: "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful):
events.text: "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive):
events.text: "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist):
events.text: "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative):
events.text: "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding):
events.text: "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Enraged Scream):
events.text: "Enough!"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious):
events.text: "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping):
events.text: "[gasping] Give it back!"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic):
events.text: "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized):
events.text: "No!"
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CATHERINE (Vicious, Final):
events.text: "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.
events.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
